title: Program created
description: Program created. A program can be [created](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/createprogrambasedontemplateasync), [copied](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/copyprogramasync) or [imported](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/postprogramimport)

program_type.title: Program type
program_type.description: Program type. For more information, refer to [Program types](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/docs/program-types)

id.title: Program type ID
id.description:
Program type ID:
1 = CREDITO,
2 = PRE-PAGO,
3 = DEBITO,
5 = MERCHANT,
7 = CREDITO ZERO-BALANCE,
8 = PRE-PAGO ZERO-BALANCE,
9 = DEBITO ZERO-BALANCE,
11 = CURRENT ACCOUNTS,
12 = INTERNAL ACCOUNTS,
13 = CORRESPONDENT ACCOUNTS,
15 = VOUCHER

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Identifier if mode is Debit or Credit

pci.title: PCI
pci.description: Is card network Payment Card Industry (PCI) compliant?

value.title: BIN value
value.description: Six to eight-digit card network-issued Bank Identification Number (BIN) that identifies card network, provider, and program.

base_program_id.title: Base program ID
base_program_id.description: Source program ID in case of copy or import

status.title: Program status
status.description:
Program status:
* `ACTIVE` - A program is active when PCI settings and accounting stages are configured.
* `PENDING` - A program is pending when PCI settings and accounting stages are not configured. A program that is pending is not ready for use.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Program timezone. This is the [IANA (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority) time zone database] (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones) in Region/City format.

language.title: Language
language.description: Program language: * `en-US` - US English * `pt-BR` - Brazilian Portuguese. Default is `en-US`

cycle_closing.title: End of day
cycle_closing.description: Program end of day. This field is used for things like accrual basis, interest calculation, taxes, penalties, tiers, and more. Format = HH:MM:SS. Default is null.

holiday_calendar_id.title: Holiday calendar ID
holiday_calendar_id.description: Program holiday calendar ID. This field is used to define the holidays calendar for a specific program.
